title: LIFT: Latent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Cell Fate Dynamics with Single Cell Snapshots
abstract: arXiv:2611.25917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lineage tracing links cell states through clonal ancestry, but does not generally identify unique source-descendant pairings. Learning from such data therefore requires a model of conditional outcomes, rather than only the terminal population distribution. We introduce LIFT, a latent flow framework for probabilistic cell-state generation from lineage-informed couplings. Variational inference encodes alternative outcomes in a latent space, while a conditional prior enables sampling from the initial state alone. A Mean Flow decoder predicts future cell state directly, requiring one decoder evaluation per sampling, which makes it convenient to predict cell fate through large scale Monte-Carlo sampling. This construction combines a representation of one-to-many relationships with efficient sampling and an analysis of conditional prediction error. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate LIFT's ability to recover both population

translated_title: LIFT：基于单细胞快照的潜空间流匹配用于概率性细胞命运动力学预测
translated_abstract: 谱系追踪通过克隆祖先关系连接细胞状态，但通常无法确定唯一的“源细胞-后代细胞”配对关系。因此，从这类数据中学习需要一个能够建模条件结果的模型，而不仅仅是终端的群体分布。我们提出了LIFT，一个基于谱系信息耦合的潜空间流框架，用于概率性细胞状态生成。变分推断将多种可能的结果编码在潜空间中，而条件先验使得仅需从初始状态即可进行采样。Mean Flow解码器可直接预测未来细胞状态，每次采样仅需一次解码器评估，这使得通过大规模蒙特卡洛采样预测细胞命运变得十分便捷。这一构造将一对多关系的表示与高效采样以及条件预测误差分析相结合。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验证明了LIFT在恢复群体分布方面的能力。
tldr: LIFT是一个基于潜空间流匹配的概率性细胞命运预测框架，通过变分推断编码细胞状态的一对多转变关系，结合Mean Flow解码器实现单次评估即可高效采样，能够从谱系追踪数据中学习细胞条件分化结局并进行大规模蒙特卡洛采样预测。
en_tdlr: LIFT is a latent flow matching framework for probabilistic cell fate prediction that learns one-to-many cell state transitions from lineage tracing data via variational inference, and enables efficient large-scale Monte Carlo sampling with only a single decoder evaluation using a Mean Flow decoder.
